CITY OF SIGNAL HILL
  2175 Cherry Avenue • Signal Hill, California 90755-3799

  THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL
  WELCOMES YOU TO A REGULAR
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  June 27, 2023

Meetings begin at 6:00 pm with the conduct of any business permitted to be conducted in
closed session by the Brown Act (Government Code Section 54950, et seq.), if any, and with
the public portion of the meeting beginning at 7:00 pm. There is a period for public comment
on closed session matters at 6:00 pm prior to the closed session. In the event there is no
business to be conducted in closed session, the regular meeting shall begin at 7:00 pm.
There is a public comment period at the beginning of the regular meeting. Any person
wishing to comment shall be allotted three minutes per distinct item. Any meeting may be
adjourned to a time and place stated in the order of adjournment.

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting on the City’s website and outside of City
Hall. The agenda and related reports are also available for review online at
www.cityofsignalhill.org.

To view or listen to the meeting live at 7:00 p.m.:

  •  City of Signal Hill website at www.cityofsignalhill.org, select the City Council
  Meetings Link from the home page.
  •  Charter Spectrum Channel 3 or Frontier FiOS Channel 38.
  •  Call (408) 638-0968 (audio only) and enter meeting ID: 881-4793-6648, press #
  when prompted to provide participant ID, and enter passcode: 374778. If you would
  like to make a public comment, please notify the meeting host by pressing *9 on the
  telephone keypad.
To view and participate (closed session at 6:00 p.m. and regular meeting at 7:00 p.m.):

  • In-person Participation: Council Chambers of City Hall, 2175 Cherry Avenue, Signal
  Hill, California.
  • Remote Participation: Visit https://zoom.us/j/88147936648 on your desktop
  computer or laptop and enter passcode: 374778; or
  • Visit www.zoom.us on your desktop computer or laptop, click on “Join a Meeting”,
  and enter meeting ID: 881-4793-6648 and passcode: 374778 when prompted; or
  • Download the app from the app store if you are using a smart phone and enter
  meeting ID: 881-4793-6648 and passcode: 374778 when prompted.

  Page 1 of 11
 City Council  Regular  June 27, 2023

  • Please note that you will be placed in a “listen only” mode and your video feed will
  not be shared with the Council or public. If you would like to make a public comment,
  please notify the meeting host by raising your virtual hand (see hand icon at bottom of
  screen) and you will be invited to speak when the City Council is taking public
  comments. Please do not simultaneously use a microphone through Zoom and a
  cellphone/telephone. That combination results in audio problems for all participants.
  • To make a general public comment or comment on a specific agenda item, you may
  also submit your comment, limited to 250 words or less, to the City Clerk at
  cityclerk@cityofsignalhill.org not later than 5:00 p.m. on Tuesday, June 27, 2023.
  Written comments will be provided electronically to City Council and attached to the
  meeting minutes. Written comments will not be read into the record.
  • Please note that remote participation is offered as a public service and the City is
  not responsible for meeting disruptions or technical difficulties; however, if you are
  disconnected, please repeat the steps above. Submission of written comments or
  in-person participation will ensure that your comments are received.
City Council Members are compensated $722.18 per month. City Clerk and City Treasurer are
compensated $438.22 per month.

(2)  ROLL CALL

  COUNCIL MEMBER WILSON

 City Council  Regular  June 27, 2023

(7)  PUBLIC HEARING

  a.  PUBLIC HEARING - RESOLUTION AMENDING THE UNIFORM SCHEDULE
  OF CITY SERVICE FEES AND CHARGES

  Summary:

  The City published a notice in the Signal Tribune newspaper per Government
  Code Section 65091(a)(4) on June 16 and 23, 2023; and posted the notice in
  accordance with Signal Hill Municipal Code Section 1.08.010 on June 16, 2023.

  On May 25, 2023, the City Council reviewed the proposed updates to the City’s
  Uniform Schedule of Service Fees and Charges as part of the Budget
  Workshop. Based on the information presented, the City Council directed staff to
  update existing fees and charges and proceed with a public hearing to consider
  adoption of the City’s amended Uniform Schedule of Service Fees and Charges.
  Staff recommends City Council open the public hearing, consider public
  testimony, and adopt the resolution approving the proposed schedule of city
  service fees and charges.
  Recommendation:

  Adopt a resolution, entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL,
  CALIFORNIA, AMENDING RESOLUTION NO. 2022-06-6685, AMENDING THE
  UNIFORM SCHEDULE OF SERVICE FEES AND CHARGES
(8)  CITY MANAGER REPORTS

  a.  PROPOSED 2023-2025 COMMUNICATIONS PLAN

  Summary:

  The City of Signal Hill strives to provide clear, concise, proactive, transparent,
  and timely information to our residents, businesses, employees, and media
  outlets. Under direction from the City Manager, staff developed a
  Communications Plan that recognizes that our City has a diverse audience,
  promotes a transparent and honest atmosphere, and uses an omnichannel
  approach to communications by providing multiple mediums for residents and
  businesses to engage with the City Council and staff. The City Strategic Plan
  goals include the need to promote economic development and promote
  transparency in government.

  The City’s key objectives, as defined in this Communications Plan, include
  employing greater use of social media, developing marketing programs, and
  updating the City’s website. With respect to both goals and objectives, the City
  has identified a specific need to proactively share information with the
  community and promote Signal Hill as a destination for business development.

  Page 3 of 11
 City Council  Regular  June 27, 2023

  The 2023-2025 Communications Plan prepared by staff would help the City
  organize these efforts and advance multiple communications objectives that
  serve the needs of the broader community.
  Recommendation:

  Review the 2023-2025 Communications Plan, provide direction to staff, and
  adopt the proposed document as desired.
  b.  RESOLUTION ADOPTING THE ANNUAL OPERATING AND CAPITAL
  BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2023-24 (YEAR 2) AND RESOLUTION
  ESTABLISHING THE ANNUAL APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR
  2023-24

  Summary:

  The City Council will consider adopting the second year of a biennial budget for
  Fiscal Year (FY) 2023-24. The City Council reviewed the proposed FY 2023-24
  (Year 2) Operating and Capital Budget (Operating Budget) at a budget workshop
  held on May 25, 2023. The Operating Budget, as presented, is structurally
  balanced per City policy. In addition, the City Council will consider a resolution
  adopting the annual appropriations limit for Year 2, known as the Gann limit.
  Recommendations:

  1. Adopt a resolution, entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL,
  CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING THE ANNUAL OPERATING AND CAPITAL
  BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2023-24 (YEAR 2)

  2. Adopt a resolution, entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL,
  CALIFORNIA,  APPROVING  AND  ADOPTING  THE  ANNUAL
  APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2023-24
  c.  RESOLUTIONS ADOPTING A CITY-WIDE PAY SCHEDULE, MANAGEMENT
  SALARY RANGES, PART-TIME SALARY SCHEDULE, AND ESTABLISHING
  NEW  CLASS  SPECIFICATIONS  FOR  ASSISTANT  TO  CITY
  MANAGER/ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT MANAGER, COMMUNICATIONS
  OFFICER, AND EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT COORDINATOR

  Summary:

  During tonight’s meeting, the City Council will consider approving and adopting a
  City-Wide Pay Schedule and Management Salary resolution as required by the
  California Public Employees’ Retirement System (CalPERS). The City Council
  will also consider approving and adopting new class specifications for three
  newly created full-time positions: Assistant to City Manager/Economic
  Development Manager, Communications Officer, and Emergency Management
  Page 4 of 11
 City Council  Regular  June 27, 2023

  Coordinator.

  During the last 2020 labor negotiations, the City approved a 2% cost of living
  adjustment for Signal Hill Employees’ Association members and 3% cost of
  living adjustment for Signal Hill Police Officers’ Association Members, annually
  from 2021-2023. The effective date of both the Management Resolution and
  City-Wide Pay Schedule is July 1, 2023. The Management Resolution and
  City-Wide and Part-Time Pay Schedules must be approved and adopted by City
  Council in advance of the cost of living adjustment taking place.

  With City Council approval of the proposed class specifications, staff would
  proceed with the necessary recruitment actions to get the new positions filled.
  The City’s total Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) positions are thereby increased from
  124.2 in FY 2022-23 to 128.75 in FY 2023-24. These additional 4.55 positions
  reflect the increase in full-time positions and part-time hours as proposed in the
  FY 2023-24 operating budget. Staff recommends these changes in order to
  enhance service to residents and businesses; the proposed changes are
  supported by ongoing revenues.
  Recommendation:

  1. Adopt a resolution, entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL,
  CALIFORNIA, AMENDING RESOLUTION NO. 2022-12-6717, APPROVING
  AND ADOPTING A CITY-WIDE PAY SCHEDULE AS REQUIRED BY THE
  CALIFORNIA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT SYSTEM (CALPERS)

  2. Adopt a resolution, entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL,
  CALIFORNIA, AMENDING RESOLUTION NO. 2023-01-6722, APPROVING
  AND ADOPTING REVISED MANAGEMENT SALARY RANGES

  3. Adopt a resolution, entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL,
  CALIFORNIA, AMENDING SALARY RANGES FOR HOURLY, PART-TIME
  EMPLOYEES PREVIOUSLY ADOPTED BY RESOLUTION NO.
  2022-11-6714, AND REPEALING ALL PRIOR RESOLUTIONS

  4. Adopt a resolution, entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL,
  CALIFORNIA, APPROVING THE UPDATED CLASSIFICATION AND
  COMPENSATION PLAN TO INCLUDE THE ASSISTANT TO CITY
  MANAGER/ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT MANAGER, COMMUNICATIONS
  OFFICER, AND EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT COORDINATOR

  Page 5 of 11
 City Council  Regular  June 27, 2023

CALL THE CITY COUNCIL AS SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

  CHAIR HANSEN
  VICE CHAIR WOODS
  MEMBER COPELAND
  MEMBER JONES
  MEMBER WILSON
  d.  RESOLUTIONS ADOPTING INVESTMENT POLICIES

  Summary:

  The City's Investment Policy provides guidelines for the prudent investment of
  the City's available resources and outlines policies for maximizing the efficiency
  of the City's cash management process. The ultimate goal of an Investment
  Policy is to enhance the economic status of the City while protecting its pooled
  cash. In accordance with California Government Code Section 53646(a), an
  annual rendering of the City’s Investment Policy shall be presented to the City
  Council for consideration. Staff does not propose changes to the Investment
  Policy at this time. In addition, the City Council as Successor Agency, will
  consider adoption of a companion policy addressing Successor Agency funds.
  Recommendations:

  City Council:
  Adopt a resolution, entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL,
  CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING ITS INVESTMENT POLICY FOR PUBLIC FUNDS

  Successor Agency:
  Adopt a resolution, entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL AS SUCCESSOR AGENCY OF THE
  CITY OF SIGNAL, CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING ITS INVESTMENT POLICY FOR
  PUBLIC FUNDS
RECESS THE CITY COUNCIL AS SUCCESSOR AGENCY

  Page 6 of 11
 City Council  Regular  June 27, 2023

(9)  CONSENT CALENDAR

  The following Consent Calendar items are expected to be routine and
  non-controversial. Items will be acted upon by the Council at one time without
  discussion. Any item may be removed by a Council Member for discussion.
  a.  RESOLUTION AMENDING RECORDS RETENTION SCHEDULE

  Summary:

  Staff recently completed the annual review of the Records Retention Schedule
  (Schedule). All changes to the Schedule have been submitted by the City Clerk,
  approved by the City, and now require City Council approval. This action would
  amend the Schedule for the Community Development; Parks, Recreation, and
  Library Services (formerly Community Services); and Police Departments.
  Recommendation:

  Adopt a resolution, entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL,
  CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE CITY’S RECORDS RETENTION SCHEDULE
  PREVIOUSLY ADOPTED BY RESOLUTION NO. 2021-07-6628, AND
  REPEALING ALL PRIOR RESOLUTIONS
  b.  RESOLUTION DECLARING FINAL ACCEPTANCE OF THE DISCOVERY
  WELL PARK PLAY AREA RESURFACING PROJECT (PORTION OF
  PROJECT NO. 80.23006) PURSUANT TO THE PUBLIC WORKS CONTRACT
  WITH T.J. JANCA CONSTRUCTION, INC.

  Summary:

  T.J. Janca Construction, Inc. (T.J. Janca) completed work for the Discovery Well
  Park Play Area Resurfacing Project (Portion of Project No. 80.23006), “Project”,
  to the satisfaction of the Public Works Department and in accordance with the
  project plans and specifications. The final construction cost of for this project
  was $82,357. Staff is recommending final acceptance of the work performed by
  T.J. Janca and release of retention withheld.
  Recommendations:

  1. Adopt a resolution, entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL,
  CALIFORNIA, DECLARING  WORK  TO  BE  COMPLETED  IN
  CONFORMANCE WITH THE PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS FOR THE
  DISCOVERY WELL PARK PLAY AREA RESURFACING PROJECT
  (PORTION OF PROJECT NO. 80.23006) IN THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL, IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE CONTRACT ENTERED INTO BETWEEN T.J.
  JANCA CONSTRUCTION, INC. AND THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL

  Page 7 of 11
 City Council  Regular  June 27, 2023

  2. Authorize the Finance Department to release retention withheld on the
  project.
  c.  MAINTENANCE  SERVICES AGREEMENT  WITH  JJ  PROPERTY
  MAINTENANCE  NETWORK INC. FOR CUSTODIAL MAINTENANCE
  SERVICES

  Summary:

  The City Council will consider entering into a Maintenance Services Agreement
  with JJ Property Maintenance Network Inc. (JJP) for citywide custodial
  maintenance services for an amount of $152,527.00 (plus 10% for
  contingencies) for a term of one year, with a maximum of two additional
  one-year term extensions The services under this contract include janitorial
  services for city facilities including pressure washing of playgrounds at City
  parks, and on-call custodial services for special city events.
  Recommendations:

  1. Authorize the City Manager to enter into a Maintenance Services Agreement
  with JJP to provide custodial maintenance services of City building facilities,
  in a form approved by the City Attorney, with an annual contract amount of
  $152,527.00. The term of the contract agreement is for a one-year term with
  a maximum of two additional one-year term extensions.

  2. Authorize standard contingency of 10% ($15,252.70) and up to a 180-day
  term extension pursuant to the City’s Purchasing and Contract Guidelines, to
  be utilized if approved by the Public Works Director.
  d.  RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING AND APPROVING THE EXECUTION OF A
  COOPERATIVE AGREEMENT WITH THE LOS ANGELES URBAN COUNTY
  COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT (CDBG) PROGRAM FOR
  FISCAL YEARS 2024-2026

  Summary:

  The City Council will consider adopting a resolution authorizing the continued
  participation in the CDBG Program by entering into an agreement with the Los
  Angeles County Development Authority (LACDA) to administer the program for
  Fiscal Years (FY) 2024-26, effective July 1, 2024, to June 30, 2027. Adopting
  the resolution would allow the City to receive CDBG funds for future years.
  Recommendation:

  Adopt a resolution, entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL,
  CALIFORNIA, APPROVING PARTICIPATION IN THE LOS ANGELES URBAN
  COUNTY COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT PROGRAM BY

  Page 8 of 11
 City Council  Regular  June 27, 2023

  AUTHORIZING THE MAYOR, OR HIS/HER DESIGNEE TO SIGN A
  COOPERATION AGREEMENT WITH THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES
  e.  RESOLUTION APPROVING YEAR THREE PARTICIPATION IN THE LOS
  ANGELES URBAN COUNTY PERMANENT LOCAL HOUSING ALLOCATION
  GRANT PROGRAM

  Summary:

  Los Angeles County (County) was granted funding from the State’s five-year
  Permanent Local Housing Allocation (PLHA) grant program in 2020. Los
  Angeles County Development Authority (LACDA) was assigned to facilitate and
  oversee implementation of funded activities. In accordance with its Urban
  County Agreement with LACDA, the City of Signal Hill chose to participate in the
  PLHA program through an option to request local funds for alternate local
  activities related to implementation of the 6th Cycle Housing Element, as well as
  in the County’s selected Eviction Defense Program. The City previously
  submitted for Year One and Year Two PLHA grant funds. Staff is recommending
  City Council approve the resolution for the Year Three PLHA grant funds.
  Recommendation:

  Adopt a resolution, entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL,
  CALIFORNIA, APPROVING YEAR THREE PARTICIPATION IN THE LOS
  ANGELES URBAN COUNTY PERMANENT LOCAL HOUSING ALLOCATION
  PROGRAM BY AUTHORIZING THE MAYOR, OR HIS/HER DESIGNEE, TO
  SIGN A REIMBURSABLE CONTRACT WITH THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY
  DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (LACDA) ACTING ON BEHALF OF THE
  COUNTY
  f.  CONTRACT AMENDMENT REGISTER DATED JUNE 27, 2023

  Summary:

  The Contract Amendment Register is a listing of proposed contract amendments
  and project changes orders eligible for streamlined processing based upon the
  following criteria as documented in the City’s Purchasing Policy:

  ·  Funds have been authorized as part of the adopted fiscal year Operating
  Budget.
  ·  Staff are satisfied with the goods/services received to date; and
  ·  City Manager has reviewed and approved each amendment for
  streamlined processing.

  The contract amendments being presented for City Council consideration are as
  follows:

  Michael Baker International, Inc. (MBI) provides consultation services to staff to
  Page 9 of 11
 City Council  Regular  June 27, 2023

  support the City’s Parks, Recreation and Library Services Department in the
  administration of the City’s various Community Development Block Grant
  (CDBG) and Permanent Local Housing Allocation (PLHA) programs. The
  proposed amendment extends the term by one year through June 30, 2024 with
  a not-to-exceed contract amount of $82,500.

  Project Partners, Inc. provides professional consultant services for an Interim
  Water Superintendent to provide the Public Works Water Department with
  critical water utility services. The proposed amendment extends the term by 180
  days through December 27, 2023.
  Recommendation:

  Authorize the Contract Amendment Register dated June 27, 2023.

  g.  SCHEDULE OF INVESTMENTS AND MONTHLY TRANSACTION REPORT

  Summary:

  The Schedule of Investments is a listing of all surplus funds invested for both the
  City and the Successor Agency to the former Signal Hill Redevelopment Agency
  as of the date shown on the report. The monthly transaction report provides the
  changes in investments for the prior month.
  Recommendation:

  Receive and file.
  h.  WARRANT REGISTER DATED JUNE 27, 2023

  Summary:

  The Warrant Register is a listing of all general disbursements issued since the
  prior warrant register and warrants to be released upon City Council approval.
  Recommendation:

  Authorize payment of the Warrant Register dated June 27, 2023.
  i.  APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES

  Summary:

  Regular Meeting of June 13, 2023.
  Recommendation:

  Approve the meeting minutes.

 City Council  Regular  June 27, 2023

(10)  COUNCIL AGENDA--NEW BUSINESS

  COUNCIL MEMBER WILSON
  COUNCIL MEMBER JONES

  CALIFORNIA CONTRACT CITIES ASSOCIATION ANNUAL MUNICIPAL

(11)  ADJOURNMENT

  Tonight’s meeting will be adjourned in honor and memory of Julian Denis Kitchens,
  long-time Signal Hill resident, former Civil Service Commissioner, and husband to
  Mayor Tina L. Hansen. The next regular meeting of the Signal Hill City Council will be
  held on Tuesday, July 11, 2023, at 7:00 p.m. (hybrid meeting format, including
  in-person, and video and teleconference participation options). Instructions to
  participate in the meeting will be provided on the meeting agenda.
CITIZEN PARTICIPATION

  Routine matters are handled most quickly and efficiently if contact is made with the City
  department directly concerned. However, if you would like to request that a matter be
  presented for City Council consideration, you may do so by writing to the City Council,
  City Clerk, or City Manager. The deadline for agenda items is 12 noon on the Tuesday
  preceding the Council and Agency meetings. The complete agenda, including back up
  materials is available on the City website on the Friday preceding the meeting.

  If you need special assistance beyond what is normally provided to participate in City
  meetings, the City will attempt to accommodate you in every reasonable manner.
  Please call the City Clerk's office at (562) 989-7305 at least 48 hours prior to the
  meeting to inform us of your particular needs and to determine if accommodation is
  feasible.
